title: Momcozy DeepClean D8 Bottle Washer, Sterilizer & Dryer - Precision Cleaning
bullets: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐍𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐀𝐮𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: The Momcozy D8 DeepClean Bottle Washer goes beyond standard bottle washers with targeted cleaning for pump parts, narrow tubing, valves, and daily feeding accessories—all in one seamless cycle. With large-capacity washing, drying, and self-cleaning care, it’s built for the real demands of modern feeding routines.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝟖-𝐁𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐆𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐍𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐬: Built for frequent feeding and daily pumping, the DeepClean Bottle Washer cleans up to 8 bottles plus pump parts and accessories in one cycle. Dedicated racks and holders help fit bottles, shields, nipples, and more with fewer repeat loads.
𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐓𝐢𝐧𝐲 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭: TargetWash Technology directs focused spray to nipples, tubing, valves, and other small accessories for a thorough clean.

𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞: Powered by HydroJet system with 64 precision spray jets, the Momcozy D8 DeepClean Bottle Washer uses 154.4°F high-temperature water to help break down stubborn milk residue and buildup. TÜV SÜD certified for tested cleaning performance.

𝐎𝐧𝐞-𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐜𝐡 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐑𝐞𝐟𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐡: A clean machine helps support cleaner bottles. Self-Clean mode refreshes internal water lines and the wash chamber, helping reduce limescale and buildup over time. Includes Momcozy descaling tablets for long-term performance.

𝐏𝐚𝐜𝐤𝐚𝐠𝐞 & 𝐔𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐆𝐮𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬: Your purchase includes a 1-year warranty, 60 cleaning tablets, 4 descaling tablets, dedicated inserts for nipples and pump parts, and everything needed to start a smoother bottle-cleaning routine right out of the box.
